narrative.overview: This is the marketing/landing surface for the StreetEats native app, built directly from the app's theme.js tokens then hand-adapted for static HTML/CSS. It carries the app's core identity faithfully: cream paper ground, thick ink borders, hard offset shadows, Young Serif headlines over uppercase Archivo Bold labels and buttons. As a Persuade-mode surface it takes one liberty the app's Operate-mode surfaces don't: interactive hover feedback on the primary CTA, since hover is a legitimate web affordance with no equivalent on a native touch app. Same anti-references as the app: no awning-stripe decoration, no glossy corporate food-delivery-app chrome. Component philosophy: hand-painted and sturdy, same as the app.
keyCharacteristics: Same palette, border, and shadow language as the native app — this site should always read as the same brand, not a separate marketing skin
CSS custom properties (:root) are this project's token mechanism, defined per-page (no shared stylesheet yet)
One confirmed web-only exception to the app's shadow rules: the primary CTA's hover state shifts and shrinks its offset shadow to read as a physical press
Static teardrop map-pin SVGs (identical path data to the native app's PinMarker) illustrate the four status colours in the legend grid

rules.name: The Status Color Lock Rule
rules.body: live/sched/closed/inactive appear only inside the four-pin legend grid, illustrating what the colours mean — never reused decoratively elsewhere on the page.

rules.name: The Two-Font Discipline Rule
rules.body: Every page that renders brand type must load both Google Fonts (Young Serif and Archivo 400/500/700) via the same preconnect + stylesheet pattern index.html uses. privacy.html was missing this until this pass added it — treat a missing font link on any new page as a bug.

rules.name: The Web Hover Exception Rule
rules.body: Unlike the native app (shadows are purely structural, never respond to interaction), .btn-primary:hover shifts translate(1px,1px) and shrinks its shadow — a deliberate, confirmed web-only exception scoped to button press feedback, not extended to cards or passive surfaces.

rules.name: The Text-Safe Paprika Rule
rules.body: --paprika and --paprika-text are not interchangeable. Use --paprika only for box-shadow; use --paprika-text for anything that renders as text (including pseudo-element bullets). --paprika fails WCAG AA contrast on both --cream and --surface when used as text.

rules.name: The Named-Role Rule
rules.body: Every font-size should map to one of the eight named roles (Display/H1, H2, H3, Subhead, Body, Button, Hint, Label) rather than a bespoke rem value. An earlier version of this site had five different roles computing to near-identical sizes (12.5px-14.7px) purely by coincidence of independently-chosen values.

dos: Do load both brand Google Fonts on every new page.
Do keep the primary CTA's hover press-shadow effect scoped to buttons.
Do use box-shadow: Npx Npx 0 <color> (zero blur, hard offset) for any new elevated element.
Do reserve the four status colours for the pin legend only.
donts: Don't reintroduce awning-stripe decoration or move toward a glossy food-delivery-app look.
Don't treat the :root CSS custom properties as a shared stylesheet — each HTML file currently redeclares its own :root block independently.
Don't ship a new page without verifying its fonts actually load.
